rejected.heading: The moderator asked you to fix this listing
rejected.footer: Fix these and submit the listing again — you don't need to fill everything in from scratch.

ROOM.label: Room
ROOM.hint: A room in an apartment or house

TOWNHOUSE.label: Townhouse
TOWNHOUSE.hint: A unit in a row of attached houses

step0.title: What are you renting out?
step0.lead: Let's start with this — everything else can be filled in gradually.
step0.draftSaved: Draft saved. You can come back to it at any time.

step1.title: Where is the place?
step1.lead: The exact address isn't shown in the listing. On the map, guests will see an approximate point within a few hundred metres.
step1.cityPlaceholder: Start typing or pick from the list
step1.cityHint: A city from the list fills in its map point automatically. You can enter another city too, but we don't show a map point for it yet.
step1.pinHint: Click the map or drag the pin — this is the (approximate) point guests will see. A listing can't be published without it.
step1.districtHint: Optional, but it helps guests get their bearings
step1.exactAddressSummary: Exact address — only for confirmed bookings
step1.exactAddressHint: The street and building number are shown only to guests with a confirmed booking. Until then the address is hidden even from people who've messaged you.
step1.apartmentHint: Never shared with anyone until a booking is confirmed

step2.title: Photos
step2.lead: The first photo becomes the cover photo in the listing. Good photos help guests see whether the place suits them.
step2.dropHint: JPEG, PNG, or WebP, up to 10 MB each
step2.needOne: You need at least one photo before you can submit the listing for review.

step3.title: Tell us about the place
step3.lead: Guests use this information in filters, so it's worth filling in accurately.
step3.titleHint: 8 to 120 characters. This is the headline guests will see.
step3.descriptionHint: Tell guests about the place: what's convenient about it, what's nearby, and who it especially suits.

step4.title: What does the place have?
step4.lead: Only tick what's actually there — guests confirm amenities after their stay.

step5.title: House rules
step5.lead: Clear rules cut down on requests that wouldn't have worked out anyway.

step6.title: How long do you rent it for?
step6.lead: Kvaterka works for anything from a single night to a year. Set the boundaries — guests will only see options that fit.

step7.title: Price
step7.lead: Guests see the total amount before booking, so it's important to include everything that's part of the payment.
step7.priceHint: The base rate. Discounts for longer stays can be set up later.
step7.cleaningHint: A one-time amount. Leave blank if there isn't one.
step7.utilitiesMeteredHint: Guests will see "metered" — the platform won't invent an amount that can't be calculated in advance.
step7.depositHint: Refunded at checkout. Leave blank if there's no deposit.
step7.negotiationHint: Guests can propose their own terms, and you can accept or decline.

INSTANT.label: Instant
INSTANT.hint: Guests book right away, no confirmation needed

step8.title: Review the listing
step8.lead: This is how guests will see it. Any step can still be changed.
step8.submitHint: After submission, a moderator will review the listing. We'll let you know the outcome — review time depends on the queue.

errors.titleTooShort: The title must be at least 8 characters.
errors.invalidDuration: The maximum stay can't be shorter than the minimum.
